# Agent Sandbox

> Python SDK for the Alibaba Cloud FC Agent Sandbox service.
> Runtime client: create, use and kill sandboxes. Template build and deploy live in the
> `abx` CLI. E2B-shaped method names ease migration; see docs/en/guide/migrate-from-e2b.md.
>
> This repository (python-sdk) contains the Python SDK as two lock-step PyPI
> distributions: client-sdk/ (`agent-sandbox`, import `agent_sandbox`) and
> server-sdk/ (`agent-sandbox-server`, import `agent_sandbox.server`, the
> container-side runtime). The `abx` command-line tool is a separate Node.js project in the
> `cli` repository (https://github.com/alibaba-agent-sandbox/agent-sandbox).

## Purpose

Agent Sandbox lets AI agents and developers create, manage, and interact
with secure cloud sandboxes. It provides isolated execution environments for
running untrusted code, file operations, and shell commands — designed for
LLM tool-use and agentic workflows.

AI coding tools: the static Agent Skills guide (SKILL.md) ships with the `abx`
CLI and is documented in the `cli` repository; see "Related: the abx CLI" below.

## Architecture

Five-layer architecture (lower layers never import upper layers):

- L1 Transport & Auth: HTTP/2 connection pooling, WebSocket, API Key / AK-SK auth
- L2 Core Protocol: envd REST + WebSocket, sandbox lifecycle, filesystem, process, terminal, port
- L3 High-Level API: Sandbox class, file ops, code execution, named commands, network helpers
- L4 Declarative API: @sandbox decorator for automatic remote execution with serialisation
- L5 Agent Integration: MCP tool server, tool definitions (agents run through the Agents API, /v1/agents/**)

## Key APIs

### SDK (Python, async-first)

```python
from agent_sandbox import Sandbox

async with await Sandbox.create(template="python-hello") as sb:
    result = await sb.run_code("print('hello')")      # code execution
    await sb.files.write("/tmp/f.txt", b"data")       # file I/O
    proc = await sb.commands.run("ls /tmp")            # raw shell command
    out = await sb.run("hello", name="Ada")            # command registered in the sandbox server
```

## Source Layout

- client-sdk/src/agent_sandbox/transport/ — HTTP, WebSocket, auth, codec
- client-sdk/src/agent_sandbox/protocol/ — sandbox lifecycle, filesystem, process, terminal
- client-sdk/src/agent_sandbox/models/ — Pydantic data models, error hierarchy
- client-sdk/src/agent_sandbox/api/ — Sandbox class, file/code/command/network APIs
- client-sdk/src/agent_sandbox/agent/ — MCP server, tool definitions
- client-sdk/src/agent_sandbox/compat/ — E2B migration helper (partial)
- client-sdk/src/agent_sandbox/declarative/ — @sandbox decorator
- client-sdk/src/agent_sandbox/integrations/ — Framework adapters (planned — directory currently empty; see ADR 2026-09-23)
- server-sdk/src/agent_sandbox/server/ — container-side runtime (`agent-sandbox-server`): HTTP routes, command registry, PTY, dev tools, browser

## Related: the abx CLI

The `abx` command-line tool (`@agent-sandbox/cli`, Node.js) shares sandboxes,
templates and credentials with this SDK but is developed and documented in the
`cli` repository. Its README, command reference, tutorials, MCP server commands
and Agent Skill (SKILL.md) live there:

- CLI README: https://github.com/alibaba-agent-sandbox/agent-sandbox/blob/main/README.md
- Agent usage skill: https://github.com/alibaba-agent-sandbox/agent-sandbox/blob/main/SKILL.md
- Agent skill installation: https://github.com/alibaba-agent-sandbox/agent-sandbox/blob/main/docs/en/guide/agent-skill-installation.md
- CLI reference: https://github.com/alibaba-agent-sandbox/agent-sandbox/blob/main/docs/en/reference/cli-reference.md
